outputs.explanation: The bar chart shows mean ± s.d. of three independent experiments (Trypan blue cell death assay) without overlaid individual data points; only error bars are shown.
The bar chart shows cell death percentages with error bars but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Grouped bar chart shows mean ± s.d. of three experiments across time points, but individual data points are not displayed.
Bar chart of cell death (%) shows mean values with error bars only; no individual data points are shown on top of the bars.
